The '''Volgastani Summer Revolution''' was an 1891 upheaval in the [[Volgastani-Hamed Empire]].

== Causes ==

The old Northern Alliance source links the revolution to public anger after the empire's defeat in the [[Svetian War]], economic and social pressures, and anti-foreign resentment. The humiliation of reparations and the diplomatic quarter in [[Murah]] made foreign influence a visible symbol of the empire's weakness.

== Siege Of Murah ==

The most important recorded episode of the revolution was the [[Siege of Murah]], when anti-foreign rebels trapped diplomats, merchants, and other foreign communities in the city for seventy-one days.

== Consequences ==

The source list of defunct nations gives the Volgastani-Hamed Empire's end date as 1892. This draft treats the Summer Revolution and Murah crisis as the immediate political breakdown before that collapse without inventing the exact abdication or successor arrangement.
